questions.question: The average height of A, B and C is 148 cm. If the average height of A and B is 136 cm and that of B and C is 125 cm, then what is the height (in cm) of B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average height of A, B, & C = 148

Average height of A & B = 136

Average height of B & C = 125

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of observation &div
ide; no. of observation

**Calculation:**

A + B + C = 148 × 3 = 444 ----(1)

A + B = 136 × 2 = 272 ----(2)

B + C = 125 × 2 = 250 ----(3)

Subtract equation (2) from equation (1)

A + B + C – A – B = 444 – 272

⇒ C = 172

Putting value of C in equation (3), we get

B + 172 = 250

**∴ B = 250 – 172 = 78 cm**

questions.question: If 60% of total articles are sold at a loss of 50% and remaining articles are sold at a proﬁt of 50%, then what will be the overall loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let total articles = 100

And, total CP of articles = Rs. 100

If 60% of total articles are sold at a loss of 50% and the remaining articles are sold at a profit of 50%

So, SP of 60 articles = 60 × 50/100 = 30

And, SP of 40 article = 40 × 150/100 = 60

Total SP of all article = 60 + 30 = 90

∴ loss% = (CP – SP)/CP × 100 = (100 – 90) /100 × 100 = 10%

questions.question: If three successive discounts of 20%, 30% and 40% are given, then what will be the net discount (in percentage)?
questions.solution:
Given:

The successive discount are 20%, 30% and 40%.

Formula:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

⇒ 20 + 30 - 600/100

⇒ 44%

Now, again

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 44%, Y = 40%

⇒ 44 + 40 - (44 × 40)/100

⇒ 84 - 176/10

⇒ 84 - 17.6 = 66.4%

∴ The single equivalent discount is 66.4%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

Let MP be 100

SP after discount = 100 × 80/100 × 70/100 × 60/100 = 33.6

We know, discount = MP – SP

So, net discount = 100 – 33.6 = 66.4

∴ Discount % = 66.4/100 × 100 = 66.4

questions.question: R is 80% more efﬁcient than S. If S alone can make a book in 90 days, then R alone can make the book in how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Efficiency of R = 80% more than S

No. of days S take to complete task = 90 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let efficiency of S be 100

Thus, Efficiency of R = 100 × 180/100 = 180

Ratio of their efficiency R : S = 180 : 100 = 9 : 5

If S alone can make a book in 90 days,

So, Total work = 90 × 5 = 450

**∴ R alone can complete the book = 450/9 = 50 days**

questions.question: Diameter of a car wheel is 21 cm. A car driver moving at the speed of 66 km/hr takes 36 seconds to reach a destination. How many revolutions will the wheel make during the journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/661340121ece4245dffae37dda41ddab0ce1f2bf0ba4a0210bff82185deedb2e.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Distance** = Speed × Time = (66 × 5/18) × 36 = 660 m = 66000 cm.

**Circumference** of wheel = πd = (22/7) × 21 = 66 cm.

**Revolutions** = Total Distance ÷ Circumference = 66000 ÷ 66 = 1000.

**∴ The correct answer is 1000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84b0cc83321393e7b7c4fd18244706aacf48911fa9d4ad3bd90be5ab586bebe4.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **Diameter** of the car wheel (d) = 21 cm

⇒ **Speed** of the car (v) = 66 km/hr

⇒ **Time** taken (t) = 36 sec

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76a19d4d06e0b451b3026847bfa603287e80263e6f79ddd3d57decce5be58338.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, convert **Speed** from km/hr to m/s:

⇒ Speed = 66 × (5/18) m/s = (11 × 5)/3 = 55/3 m/s

⇒ **Total Distance** covered (D) = Speed × Time

⇒ D = (55/3) × 36 = 55 × 12 = 660 meters

⇒ Convert distance to centimeters: D = 660 × 100 = 66000 cm

⇒ **Circumference** of the wheel (C) = π × d

⇒ C = (22/7) × 21 = 22 × 3 = 66 cm

⇒ **Number of Revolutions** (n) = Total Distance ÷ Circumference

⇒ n = 66000 ÷ 66 = 1000

⇒ Therefore, the wheel makes 1000 revolutions, which corresponds to option (4).

**∴ The correct answer is 1000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **__Additional Information__**

Circumference of a Circle

The distance covered by a wheel in one complete revolution is equal to its circumference, given by 2πr or πd.

Unit Conversions

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert meters to centimeters, multiply by 100.

Distance Formula

Distance = Speed × Time. Ensure all units are consistent (e.g., speed in m/s and time in seconds) before calculation.</p

questions.solution:

questions.question: The total surface area of a hemisphere is 1039.5 cm². Find its diameter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total surface area of a hemisphere = 1039.5 cm2.

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of a hemisphere = 3πr²

where r → radius of the hemisphere

**Calculation:**

Total surface area of a hemisphere = 1039.5

⇒ 3πr² = 1039.5

⇒ 3 × 22/7 × r² = 1039.5

⇒ r² = 110.25

⇒ r = 10.5

**∴ Diameter of the hemisphere = 10.5 × 2 = 21 cm**
